kebab_example: aliyun mts register-custom-face --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --image-url http://example-0000.jpeg --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterCustomFace

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person library, which uniquely identifies a custom person library. The ID is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness. Keep this ID secure for use in subsequent API calls.
<notice>The ID cannot be the same as a system person library ID. If they are the same, the system person library is used by default. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物库ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用）。
<notice>不能与系统⼈物库ID相同，如果相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。></notice>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person, which uniquely identifies a custom person. The ID is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness. Keep this ID secure for use in subsequent API calls.
The ID can be up to 120 characters in length, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. The returned FaceId is of the String type
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用） 。
最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写，返回FaceId为String类型
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.help_en: The public URL of the face image to be registered. The image must contain one and only one front-facing face
parameters.help_zh: 需要注册的⼈脸图⽚公网地址，图⽚中有且仅包含⼀张正脸
parameters.name: image_url
